user.title: WD My Cloud
user.description: Enter the address of your WD My Cloud NAS (for example {host_example}). Do not include http:// or https://.

data_description.Host: IP address or hostname, optionally with a port. Do not include http:// or https://.
data_description.Username: Admin account used to sign in to the NAS.
data_description.Password: Password for the admin account. WD firmware allows only one active admin session.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate WD My Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The NAS rejected the stored credentials. Enter the password again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WD My Cloud
reconfigure.description: Update the NAS address or credentials. The serial number is checked to keep this entry linked to the same NAS.

data_description.Host: IP address or hostname, optionally with a port. Do not include http:// or https://.
data_description.Username: Admin account used to sign in to the NAS.

error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a scheme, path or credentials.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password, or another admin session is already active on the NAS.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the NAS.

abort.wrong_device: The NAS at this address is a different device. Add it as a new integration entry instead of reconfiguring this one.

init.title: WD My Cloud options
init.description: Polling interval must be between {min_interval} and {max_interval} seconds.

data_description.update_interval: Seconds between polls. The default is 600.

fetch_failed.message: Error fetching data from the NAS: {error}

reauth_fetch_failed.message: Failed to fetch data after re-authentication: {error}

unexpected_fetch_failed.message: Unexpected error fetching data from the NAS: {error}

power_action_blocked.message: The NAS refused the power action because its safety check returned code {code}.

os2_not_supported.message: This entry was created for OS2 firmware, which is no longer supported. Delete the entry and add the NAS again after updating it to OS5.
